name: NAMI Yamhill County
description: Local affiliate of the National Alliance on Mental Illness offering free peer-led education and support programs (NAMI Basics, Family-to-Family, Connection, Peer-to-Peer, In Our Own Voice) for people living with mental illness and their families in Yamhill County.
registrationNote: Local chapter/affiliate of the national NAMI organization; likely no separate Yamhill-addressed IRS registration.

name: Blanchet Farm
description: A residential addiction-recovery program on a working farm in Carlton where men recovering from substance use disorder receive up to a year of free room, board and structure while doing farm work, gardening and woodworking; the site also hosts AA/NA meetings for Yamhill County.
registrationNote: Program/site of Blanchet House of Hospitality (Portland-based nonprofit); operates under Blanchet House's EIN, no separate Yamhill-addressed IRS registration expected.

name: Special Olympics Oregon – Yamhill County
description: Local Special Olympics program providing year-round sports training and competition (athletics, bocce, golf, bowling, swimming, volleyball, basketball, powerlifting, cornhole) for children and adults with intellectual disabilities in Yamhill County.
registrationNote: Local county program of Special Olympics Oregon; no separate Yamhill-addressed IRS registration expected.
